validation.pipeline: tools/process_luz_sheet.py segments each full raw sheet (tools/art_sources/luz/source/) into 8-connected alpha components, decides which component is the 'body' of each nominal cell (most pixels inside that cell, seeded from the previous safe_cuts grid), and reassigns every other component -- including bled ruler-tip fragments -- to whichever cell's body is nearest. A component that is the body of two cells at once is a hard failure, never silently merged. Every frame is then repacked into a uniform 512x512 cell: horizontal placement = 100 + (source_bbox_x0 - column*313) to match the previous catalog's placement math exactly (verified within 1px on unaffected frames), vertical placement shifts the frame so its opaque bottom lands on canvas row 413.
validation.reason: Reprocessing removed every previously-documented bleed fragment (ground combat frames 5-6/6-7/9-10/10-11/13-14/14-15, air combat frame 11/15) with no floating fragments or truncated rulers in the regenerated contact sheets and onion skins (visually inspected). No cell needed a manual override or per-frame foot correction; the old safe_cuts/frame_overrides/foot_offsets band-aids are gone.
validation.contact_frames: Per-clip index (0-based, within the clip's own frame list) of the frame that should be showing when the attack's hitbox activates. ground_attack_1/2/3 are now the 8-frame T4 art (tools/process_luz_combat_hits.py, ground_attack_N_raw.png): contact_frame=3 in all three is the frame where the ruler is drawn perfectly horizontal at maximum reach (the raw art's own designed contact frame, identical across all three raw sheets by the same Codex prompt spec), measured directly (assets/player/luz/luz_ruler_track.json) rather than picked by eye. crouch_attack is still the original 4-frame placeholder art (contact_frame=1, first fully-extended pose) pending its own T4/T5 pass. up_attack=2 (ruler fully vertical at the peak of the upward swing), air_horizontal_attack=1 (first full extension) are unrelated (air combat sheet). Consumed by LuzAnimationCatalog to give frames up to and including the contact frame a shorter/longer duration so it starts exactly at attack_startup_time.
